metadata.title: Clear Prompt MIDI Diagnostic
metadata.test_design: four 2-second one-hot prompt regions aligned to the MIDI i-VI-v-iv chord changes, with 0.20-second transitions

control_roles.secondary: CFG weights from the dominant prompt slot
control_roles.expression: temperature from the dominant prompt slot
control_roles.exploration: top_k from the dominant prompt slot

slots.label: Solo Piano Chords
slots.magenta_prompt: solo acoustic grand piano only, dry close microphone, sustained minor jazz chord voicings, no drums, no bass, no synths
slots.audio_prompt_recipe: percussive piano-like chord attacks from the provided MIDI progression

slots.label: Chiptune Square Arps
slots.magenta_prompt: 8-bit chiptune square wave lead, bright retro video game synth, rapid staccato arpeggios, sharp digital beeps, no drums
slots.audio_prompt_recipe: bright square-wave 16th-note arpeggio from each MIDI chord

slots.label: Distorted 808 Drums
slots.magenta_prompt: heavy distorted 808 sub bass with punchy trap drums, loud kick and snare, aggressive electronic club rhythm
slots.audio_prompt_recipe: 808 kick/sub rhythm, snare, and hat pattern with MIDI roots

slots.label: Choir String Drone
slots.magenta_prompt: wide cinematic string orchestra and choir pad, slow ambient drone, huge reverb, soft tape noise, no percussion
slots.audio_prompt_recipe: long slow string and choir-like sustained pad from each MIDI chord
